details:
The new UI update is great for new users, all the control hints are very useful when starting out. However, for experienced users, they clutter the screen with information that have little use. 

For the most part, you can toggle most of it by swapping to the minimal HUD setting. However, there are two things you cannot turn off without completely turning off HUD: the burger menu on the top left, and the new large tooltip icons that appear on top of having normal tooltips.

First of all, I can't really see a use for the burger menu on desktop, it just seems to take up space, and its use can be done with just the ESC key. 

Second, while the enlarged tooltips are great for those that have trouble reading small text or use smaller screens, it really needs to be a toggle so those that don't need the larger text don't have it covering a large portion of the screen.

I liked the way desktop vrchat had very little GUI, it helped a little with immersion as much as one could have on desktop. I'm glad most of it is togglable, it allows new users to get the information they need while letting more experienced users keep the UI closer to what they're used to. I do think this update is going in the right direction, but it does need some more work in future updates, for me those two are the main issues I have with the UI update.
title: Toggle for the burger menu on desktop and the new tooltips
